name: Volume level per audio stream
plain: Reads the current media, ring and alarm volume without any prompt.
meaning: Shows whether the person is muted, at a meeting, or listening loud. Apps use it to warn or adapt; trackers read it as a weak behavioral signal.

android.note: Max steps differ by device: STREAM_MUSIC 15 on most phones, up to 25 on some OEM builds

ios.note: Public API gives only the system output volume; no separate ring volume is readable

data.update: On change (iOS KVO) or on poll (Android)

limits.headline: Can see how loud your phone is set, with no prompt
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks while it is open, such as a video or call app
can: See media, ring and alarm volume on Android
See the iPhone output volume while the app is open
Get told when you press the volume buttons on iPhone
Warn you if the sound is muted or very low
cannot: See a separate ring volume on iPhone; only the overall output volume is shown
Change the volume on iPhone without your tap
Count on the same volume steps on every Android; 15 is common and some go up to 25
limits.differs: Android shows each sound stream (media, ring, alarm). iPhone shows one output volume.

story.what_it_is: An app can read your current media, ring and alarm volume.
story.for_you: You never see it. An app can tell if you are muted, in a quiet meeting or playing loud music. Apps may warn you when you are about to blast sound.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to warn about loud sound, remind you to unmute and adjust alerts. Trackers read it as a weak behavior signal.

use_cases.example: A game shows a 'sound is off' banner when your media volume is zero, so you do not miss a tutorial.
A music app warns you about loud sound when headphones are on at high volume.
A video app asks if you want to unmute when you start a clip with volume at zero.
A chat app uses a softer ping when your ring volume is low.
A running app raises coach voice volume when it detects loud wind or traffic.
An ad network skips audio ads when your media volume is off.

risks: Reveals if you are in a meeting
story.android_note: Reads volume per stream with no prompt.
story.ios_note: Reads the current output volume with no prompt.

technical_bounds: No audio content is exposed, only the level
iOS cannot read the separate ringer volume or the hardware ringer switch state
